# Loopy Media
> Digital marketing agency in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. Website design from ₹799/month, social media marketing from ₹1,999/month, Meta Ads from ₹4,999/month.

## About
Loopy Media is Ahmedabad's leading digital marketing agency specializing in website design, social media marketing, branding, content creation, and paid advertising for local businesses including clinics, hospitals, restaurants, cafes, gyms, educational institutes, and startups.

## Services
- Website Design & Development (from ₹799/month)
- Social Media Marketing (from ₹1,999/month)
- Meta Ads Management (from ₹4,999/month)
- Brand Identity & Graphic Design

- Instagram Account Management
